allycrew.name: carrier crew (6-209 — 목소리 자체에 무전 느낌이 있어 필터 없음)

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [serious] An enemy land battleship is advancing on the city. [urgent] Strip its armor, cut its tracks and kill the reactor before it arrives!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [excited] Reactor destroyed! The land battleship is finished. [proud] Outstanding work, all aircraft!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [grimly] The city has fallen... [sighs] All units, withdraw.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [commanding, arrogant] All batteries, open fire. [cold] Grind a path to the city.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent] A land battleship is moving on the city! Strip its armor plates, then go for the tracks!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [focused] Armor plate down! The track behind it is exposed!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [angry, shouting] Half our tracks are gone! Keep moving, full power to the rest!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [encouraging] Half its tracks are destroyed! It is losing speed!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [alarmed] Exhaust ducts exposed! [shouting] Seal them, now!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [focused] Those glowing vents behind the tracks are its weak point. Destroy them!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [encouraging] Half its exhaust vents are gone! Keep at it!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [panicked] Reactor overheating! [shouting] Open the core shutters!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [excited, urgent] The shutters on top are open! The core is exposed, hit it with everything you have!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [strained, through gritted teeth] Core integrity at fifty percent! Hold together!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [excited] The core is failing! Keep hitting it!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent] Three kilometers to the city!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [very urgent] It is almost at the city limits! Stop it now!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [laughs menacingly] Nothing can stop us now!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [desperate, shouting] Five hundred meters! Bring it down!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [terrified] The reactor... [gasps] it is going critical!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [triumphant] Core destroyed! The battleship is going up!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [cold, satisfied] We have reached the city. [cruel] Commence bombardment.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [horrified] It is inside the city... [shaken] It is shelling the city!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [barking orders] Damage control, bring the batteries back online!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [warning] Some of its guns are back online. Watch yourselves!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: All aircraft. A single enemy ace is inbound. [uneasy] Something about that aircraft is not right. [cautious] Engage with caution.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [relieved] The ace is down and the missile is gone. [proud] Outstanding work, all aircraft!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [devastated, quietly] The missile hit the base... [sighs] All units, withdraw.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alert] Single bogey, closing fast. It is carrying a directed-energy weapon. [urgent] Do not sit in front of its nose!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, reverent] Launch authority confirmed. [softly] One warhead ends this war... and every border with it.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alarmed] Ground launch detected! A ballistic missile is climbing out of a silo. [urgent] Its target is our base!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [focused, urgent] The warhead is slaved to that ace's fire control. Shoot the ace down and the missile dies with it!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [strained] Heavy jamming! You can only get a lock from its front. [warning] Go head-on, and watch that laser!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [quietly mocking] Come at me head-on, [pause] if you still think your flag is worth dying for.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent] Two minutes to impact!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, almost gentle] Two minutes. After that, there will be no nations left to fight over.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent, shouting] One minute! Bring that ace down!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [weary, sincere] Why keep fighting? In one minute, this war ends whether you win or not.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [desperate] Thirty seconds! It is now or never!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [whispers, melancholic] Thirty seconds. Take one last look at the world they taught you to divide.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [triumphant, relieved] The ace is down! The missile lost guidance... it detonated in the upper atmosphere!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [stunned, quietly] Impact... [devastated] The base is gone.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [serene, quietly] It's done. [sighs] No more borders... no more war.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, solemn] Every border down there was drawn by a war. [quiet conviction] I'm here to fire the shot that erases them all.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [amused, taunting softly] Catch me if you can still find a border to stand on.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [pained, fading] You'll just draw the lines again... [sad] and fight over them... [whispers] forever...

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alert] Two bogeys in tight formation... [intrigued] They're aces, and they fly like brothers. [warning] Expect decoys. Make sure you're locking the real one!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [excited] Both aces are down! [lighthearted] Heads or tails, it doesn't matter now. Good work!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [confident, smooth] Heads and Tails, on station. [smirking] Let's see which side you land on.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [cool, playful] One toss for each of you. [smug] Heads, I win.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [dry humor] Every coin has two faces. [condescending] You picked the wrong one.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [cold, serious] You've earned my full attention. [menacing] You won't enjoy it.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [pained, struggling] Tails... finish the toss... [fading] without me...

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [shocked] Tails...? [cold fury] You took my little brother. [quiet rage] The game is over. Now I just win.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, commanding] Tails. Flip.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [excited, playful] Brother, save a few for me this time!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [teasing] Catch! [laughs] ...Oh, can't catch them all? [mockingly] Shame!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [mischievously] Guess which one's me! [giggles] Go on, flip for it!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [surprised, annoyed] Hey! That actually hurt!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [shocked, fading] Heads... [sad] I called it wrong...

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [screaming, furious] You shot down my brother?! [crying, angry] No more coin tosses... [shouting] I'm taking every one of you down!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [gleeful] Call it, pilots!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alert] Four bandits, tight diamond. [tense] Shade squadron... [warning] They'll stall right in front of you. Don't sit on their tails, and they can fire in any direction!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [triumphant] Shade squadron is wiped out! [proud] Outstanding flying, all aircraft!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [cold, calm] Shade flight, engage. [quietly, menacing] Let them chase shadows.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [flat, crisp] Two.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [flat, crisp] Three.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [flat, crisp] Four.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [cold, smug] Overshoot. [quietly] Your mistake.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [sharp command] Shades, break and cross!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [tense, controlled] Shade One is down. [cold] Close it up.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [tense, controlled] Shade Two is down. [cold] Close it up.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [tense, controlled] Shade Three is down. [cold] Close it up.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [tense, controlled] Shade Four is down. [cold] Close it up.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, fading] Shade One... [whispers] going dark.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, fading] Shade Two... [whispers] going dark.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, fading] Shade Three... [whispers] going dark.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, fading] Shade Four... [whispers] going dark.

lines.speaker: betty
lines.text: Pull up. Pull up.

lines.speaker: betty
lines.text: Altitude. Altitude.

lines.speaker: betty
lines.text: Railgun warning.

lines.speaker: betty
lines.text: Laser warning.

lines.speaker: betty
lines.text: Damage critical.

lines.speaker: betty
lines.text: Stall. Stall.

lines.speaker: betty
lines.text: Flares empty.

lines.speaker: betty
lines.text: Bingo fuel.

lines.speaker: betty
lines.text: Ammunition zero.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alert] All aircraft. An enemy ace is circling over the city, [tense] and she is painting it with a laser. [urgent] Something is coming down from orbit. Stop her!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [relieved] The strike missed the city! [proud] Outstanding work, all aircraft!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [devastated, quietly] The city has been hit... [sighs] All units, withdraw.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: [calm, almost tender] The city is lit. [soft, cold] All that is left... is for the sky to fall.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: [serene, commanding] Little moons... rise. [cold, protective] Keep them away from me.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alarmed] She has launched interceptor drones! They will shoot down missiles near her. [focused] Kill the drones first, or fire everything at once!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [excited] All drones are down! She is wide open, [shouting] hit her now!

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: [irritated sigh] Again, little moons. [softly, firm] Rise.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [warning] She is launching a second wave of drones!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent] Two minutes until the strike!

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: [amused, condescending] Two minutes. [leaning in, intimate] Look up... [cold] and remember how small you are.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent, shouting] One minute! Bring her down!

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: [serene, smiling] One minute. [quiet confidence] The light never misses.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [desperate] Thirty seconds! Do it now!

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: [whispering, gentle] Thirty seconds. [tender, cold] Close your eyes.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [triumphant, relieved] LUNA is down! The beam is gone... the strike has lost its target!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [stunned, quietly] Impact on the city... [devastated] It is gone.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: [melancholic, softly] And the night... [sighs] falls quiet.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: [dreamy, almost tender] The city is so bright tonight... [soft laugh] [cold, whispering] Let me make it brighter.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: [gasps, shocked] No... [trembling, fading] So this... [sad, quietly] is what falling feels like...

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: [softly, almost sweet] Stay right there... [cold, whispering] I'll make it quick... and beautiful.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: [playful, teasing] Not yet... [cold] You don't get to touch me.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [calm, professional] Copy your mark. Bomber inbound.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [focused] Bomb away.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [satisfied] Impact. Good effect on target.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [calm] Tanker drone en route. Hold steady.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [calm] Contact.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [relaxed] Transfer complete. Clear to break.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent] Breakaway, breakaway! Tanker is returning.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [calm, confident] Guardian drone on station. Missile defense active.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [calm] Guardian drone returning to base.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [confident, steady] Wingmen inbound. Forming up on you.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alarmed, urgent] Wingman down!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [calm, professional] Wingmen are bingo fuel. RTB.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, calm] Fox two.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, calm] Fox three.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, calm] Rifle.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, calm] Magnum.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, calm] Greyhound.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, calm] Bruiser.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, calm] Pickle.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, calm] Rockets away.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, calm] Music on.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, calm] Spear.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, calm] Drive, drive.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [smooth, amused] Coin's still in the air.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [excited, teasing] Ooh, shiny! [giggles] Your missile likes those better!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, quietly amused] You're aiming at a line that isn't there.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [cold, calm] You locked a shadow.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, professional] All batteries, open fire. We reach the city by nightfall.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [focused, urgent] Exhaust vents exposed! They're tucked inside the track wells, glowing blue. Destroy them and cripple that thing!

lines.speaker: crew
lines.text: [panicked, coughing] Captain, it's sixty degrees down here!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [cold, clipped] Then sweat. Divert all coolant to the reactor.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [excited, urgent] The core is exposed! Hit it with everything you have!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [flat, eerily calm] Seal the bulkheads. [pause] With them inside.

lines.speaker: crew
lines.text: [banging on metal, screaming] Open the door! Please, we're burning!

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: [synthetic, monotone] Crew unresponsive. Automated fire control engaged.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alarmed] Every gun is back on automatic! Stay on the core!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [strained, voice cracking] Override the safeties! We are NOT stopping!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, almost peaceful] Reactor critical. [pause] All hands... [breaking] all hands, keep moving forward-

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [exhausted, hollow] We made it. It cost everything. [cold] Commence bombardment.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: [synthetic] Battery restored.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [commanding, urgent] Reroute reactor power to the batteries. [shouting] All of them. Now!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [shouting, desperate] Keep firing! Keep fir—

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alarmed, urgent] It's feeding reactor power to its guns! Every battery is back! Stay on the core!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [screaming in agony] AAAAAAHHHH!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alert] New contact, single bandit, unknown type! [tense] He's coming out of the sun. [urgent] Watch your missiles!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [triumphant] The enemy ace is down! [proud] Outstanding flying, all aircraft!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [old, aristocratic, slow and measured] You trespass on land my family has held for three centuries. [calm, dignified resolve] I shall see you off it myself.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [old gentleman, amused, unhurried] Follow me into the light... [quietly] if you dare.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [old aristocrat, warm pride] The sun has always favoured my house.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [old, softly amused] Your missile bows to the sun. [dignified] As it should.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [old gentleman, mild reproach] Manners, young one. [calm, firm] One does not shoot a gentleman in the back.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [old, polite, dry] Too slow, I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [confused, then amazed] He's hit, but nothing vital! [disbelief] He keeps turning his engines and cockpit away from our fire. [stunned] He's doing damage control by flying!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [old, deep, weary pride] There are pilots like you in every generation. [slow, cold certainty] And I've felled every last one of them.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [shocked, shouting] He turned on a dime! [urgent warning] Don't chase him into the sun!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [old, strained, then peaceful] Ah... [quiet, accepting] it seems the time has come... [softly] to pass it on to the next generation.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [relieved, triumphant] Leviathan confirmed destroyed. The carrier is safe. [proud] Outstanding work, all aircraft!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [grim, quiet] The carrier is lost... [heavy] All aircraft, divert to the nearest airfield.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alarmed, urgent] Multiple launches detected! Sub-launched cruise missiles, inbound on our carrier! [commanding] All aircraft, return to the fleet and intercept!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [cold, calm, menacing] Leviathan to all tubes. [quiet] Bury that carrier.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alert, urgent] Sonar has a large submerged contact closing on the fleet! [commanding] All aircraft, return to the carrier and fly cap!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [quiet, cold, predatory] Periscope depth. [slow, satisfied] There she is... the carrier. [calm order] Flood all tubes.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [commanding, fierce] All tubes, fire! [cold fury] Bury that carrier!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alarmed, urgent] Vampire, vampire! Cruise missiles launched from the sub! [commanding] Splash them before they reach the carrier!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent] The sub is launching drones! [sharp warning] Watch your six!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [cold, clipped] Drones away. [dismissive] Keep them off my back.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alert] More drones from the sub!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent] Vampire, vampire! Missiles inbound!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent warning] Missiles are pulling up for a terminal dive! Splash them before they come down on the carrier!

lines.speaker: ally
lines.text: [shaken, then steady] We're hit! Damage control's on it. [determined] We'll hold. You just stop the next one!

lines.speaker: ally
lines.text: [strained, over alarms] Hull integrity critical... [steady, sincere] but nobody's left their post. Every one of us is counting on you!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, resolute] Launch tubes are empty. Surface the boat. [cold] We finish this ourselves.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [focused] Its missiles are spent. It has to come up to fight. Watch for the sonar marks!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alert] Sonar contact! It's surfacing inside the marked circle!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent] The sub has surfaced! Hit it before it dives!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [crisp, commanding] Damaged mounts back online. [cold] Engage!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [warning] It repaired its guns while it was under. Watch yourselves!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent] It's diving! Torpedo in the water, headed for the carrier!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [shouting, fanatical] Blow all ballast! Ramming speed! [manic, feverish] One carrier, and this war ends tomorrow. Ten million lives saved, and all it costs is ours! [laughing madly] This isn't suicide. It's salvation!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alarmed] It's going to ram the carrier! [disbelief] That captain's lost his mind. [urgent] Sink it before it hits!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent] Torpedoes in the water! Sink it before it fires again!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [choking, desperate] No... so close... [broken, bitter] ten million people... [hateful whisper] they'll die because of you...!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [excited] Leviathan is sinking! Splash the sub!

lines.speaker: ally
lines.text: [proud, steady] It's down! The whole crew's cheering on the flight deck. [grateful] Thank you, all of you!

lines.speaker: ally
lines.text: [panicked, over alarms] We're going under! Abandon ship!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [ecstatic, unhinged] Do you see it? Peace, floating right there! [laughing] History will remember us as saviors!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent] Two kilometers to the carrier! Stop that sub!

lines.speaker: ally
lines.text: [calm, resolute] Nobody's running. [firm] We trust you!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [screaming, ecstatic] For the ten million!

lines.speaker: ally
lines.text: [shouting, impact] Collision! It rammed us... [desperate] we're going down!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [frenzied, shouting] Fix those guns! Weld the hatches shut if you have to! [manic] Today we save ten million!

lines.speaker: ally
lines.text: [relieved, then commanding] Missiles are done. [brisk orders] Deck crew, clear the flight deck! Hangar, load ordnance for our pilots! [warm, steady] We'll have a deck waiting for you. [firm] Go hunt that sub!

lines.speaker: allycrew
lines.text: [sharp, eager] Aye aye, sir! [busy, shouting over noise] Clearing the deck, ordnance coming up!

lines.speaker: ally
lines.text: [calm, steely] It's coming straight for us. [commanding] Damage control teams, stand by! [resolute] Our pilots will stop it. [commanding] Helm, hold course!

lines.speaker: allycrew
lines.text: [firm, steady under pressure] Aye aye, sir! Holding course!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent] Enemy reinforcements inbound! Cover the convoy!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent] Enemy reinforcements inbound! Get the convoy home!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent] Enemy reinforcements inbound! Cover the landing craft!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [serious, focused] Enemy command vehicles are hiding in the city among civilian traffic. Fly low and get eyes on before you shoot.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [firm, clear] Hostile vehicle confirmed. Weapons free on that one only.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [satisfied, brief] Hostile vehicle destroyed.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [sharp, alarmed] Civilian vehicle hit! Watch your fire!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [angry, stern warning] That's two civilians down. One more and we abort the operation!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [relieved, approving] All hostile vehicles are down. Clean work, all aircraft.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [grim, disappointed] Too many civilian casualties. We're calling off the operation. All aircraft, return to base.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [serious, urgent] Enemy TELs are hiding inside the tunnel. They'll roll out one at a time. Don't let them launch!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alarmed, fast] A TEL is rolling out of the tunnel! Hit it before it sets up!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, matter-of-fact] Datalink. Coordinates received.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [calm] UAV en route to your mark.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [confident, steady] Wingmen inbound to the marked area. Holding cap.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [calm, professional] Wingmen bingo fuel. Leaving the area.

lines.speaker: allycrew
lines.text: [sharp, eager] Aye aye, sir! [shouting over noise] Cruise missiles away!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [reverent, ecstatic whisper] Let there be light. [rising, fervent] Caliburn opens its eye... [zealous, triumphant] and this sky will be cleansed.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alert, urgent] Optical weapon tower detected! [focused] Its jammers are shielding the power grid. Find the three ECM vehicles and take them out!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [calm, instructive] Your missiles won't lock the vents while the jammers are up. [firm] ECM vehicles first!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [focused] ECM vehicle down!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [firm, focused] One jammer left. [urgent] Take it out!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [cold, fervent] You tore away our veil? [rising, zealous] Then face the light unshielded.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [relieved, then urgent] Jamming is down! The exhaust vents on the power towers are exposed. Hit them!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [focused] Vent destroyed!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent] Last vent! [firm] Knock it out!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alarmed, urgent] Laser lock on one of you! Break hard, don't fly straight!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent] Reflector net forming! Watch the blue lines and find a gap!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [focused] Reflector down!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [shaken, then defiant] The mirrors are broken... [fervent] but the light needs no mirrors!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [satisfied] All reflectors are down. No more nets!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [warning] Their guns around the tower are back online. Watch the low approach!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [commanding, zealous] Faithful, take wing! [fervent] Guard Caliburn!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alert] Enemy fighters inbound over the tower!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [ecstatic, reverent] Pour everything into the lens. [solemn, booming] The light is judgment.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent, instructive] All vents down! The lens overheats after every shot. Hit it the moment it fires!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [excited, urgent] The lens is glowing red! Hit it now!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alert, urgent] Lens is open again. Strike now!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [desperate, fervent] The vessel cracks, but the light endures! [screaming] Give it everything!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [encouraging] The lens is cracking! Keep it up!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [broken, despairing whisper] No... the light... [sobbing] it is leaving us!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent] Lens destroyed! Get clear, the tower is coming down!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [relieved, proud] The tower is down. Outstanding work, all aircraft.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [serious] Optical weapon tower detected. Its jammers are shielding the power grid. [urgent] Take out the ECM vehicles first!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [proud] The tower is down. All aircraft, outstanding work.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [grim] We could not bring down the tower. [heavy] All units, withdraw.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [commanding, aggressive] All squadrons, converge on the zone. [cold] Sweep them from the sky.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alert, urgent] Multiple bandits closing on the zone. It's going to be a furball. [firm] Stay with your wingman.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alert] More bandits inbound. [tense] They keep throwing fighters at us.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [furious, shouting] Losses are irrelevant. Send everything we have!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [focused] They're taking losses, but they keep coming. [firm] Keep the pressure on.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [excited, urgent] Just a few more kills and their air wing breaks!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [tense, urgent] We lost a wingman! [firm] Keep fighting!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [desperate, strained] Too many losses... [breaking] All units, disengage!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [triumphant] They're breaking off! The enemy air wing is in full retreat!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [serious] Enemy is committing its entire air wing to this sector. [firm] Bleed them until they break.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [proud] Airspace is ours. Their air wing is broken. Outstanding work.
